/**
 * Provides static methods for generating keyboard template blocks from `LabelKeyboard` definitions.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * This class generates HTML-like `<keyboard>` blocks for the template engine. Requires `LabelKeyboard` to be set via {@link BlockKeyboard.label} before using {@link BlockKeyboard._build}.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // blocks/keyboard.ts
 * import { BlockKeyboard, LabelKeyboard } from "gramstax";
 *
 * class KeyboardBlock extends BlockKeyboard {
 *   static label = class extends LabelKeyboard {
 *     static backNext = {en: "Back, Next", id: "Kembali, Lanjut"}
 *   }
 *   static backNext = (lang?: string, type?: string) => this._build(`backNext`, lang, type)
 * }
 *
 * // base/page.ts
 * import {KeyboardBlock} from "~/blocks/keyboard"
 * export abstract class PageBase extends CtxCore {
 *   static kbk = KeyboardBlock
 *   static kbl = KeyboardBlock.label
 * }
 *
 * // pages/some.ts
 * import {PageBase} from "~/base/page"
 * export class SomePage extends PageBase {
 *   static template = `
 *     <base>
 *       ${this.kbk.backNext()}
 *       <message>Default message hello world</message>
 *     </base>
 *     <base id="others-id-1">
 *       <message>Message from others id 1 with keyboard from base id default</message>
 *     </base>
 *     <base id="others-id-2">
 *       <base>${this.kbk.backNext()}</base>
 *       <message>Message from others id 3 with keyboard in same base</message>
 *     </base>
 *   `
 * }
 *
 * // understanding example
 * this.kbk.backNext() // will show all language with block template
 * this.kbk.backNext("id") // will show all language only (lang="id") with block template
 * this.kbk.backNext("default") // will show all language only (lang="default" or without lang) with block template
 * ```
 *
 * @public
 */
members.name: BlockKeyboard

/**
 * Extends {@link https://github.com/jaredwray/keyv | Keyv} to provide a unified caching interface with built-in support for memory and Redis storage.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * Storage modes: - **Memory mode:** when `url` is `"memory"` (default), uses an in-memory `Map`. - **Redis mode:** when `url` starts with `"redis"`, uses `@keyv/redis` adapter. - **Custom mode:** when `more.forceStore` is provided, uses the custom store.
 *
 * @typeParam V - The type of values stored in the cache.
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * import { CacheExternal } from "gramstax";
 *
 * // Memory cache (default)
 * const memoryCache = new CacheExternal();
 *
 * // Redis cache
 * const redisCache = new CacheExternal("redis://localhost:6379", 3600000, "s");
 *
 * // With namespace and TTL
 * const cache = new CacheExternal("memory", 60000, "myapp");
 *
 * // Set and get data
 * await cache.set("user:123", { name: "John" });
 * const user = await cache.get("user:123");
 * ```
 *
 * @public
 */
members.name: CacheExternal

/**
 * Routes an incoming update to the appropriate page handler.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * The routing follows a strict **priority hierarchy**. When a match is found at any level, the method executes the handler and returns immediately. If no match is found, it falls through to the next level.
 *
 * **Routing Priority (executed in order):**
 *
 * 1. **staticSession** - Session-based routes (O(1) lookup) - Checks if user has an active session with a matching method - Skips if the input matches a static or staticIntent route - Example: `textFree` with session method "7-mypage"
 *
 * 2. **static** - Exact intent match routes (O(1) lookup) - Matches exact text/callback data to page intents - Example: "start" → `handleText()`, "/help" → `handleCommandText()`
 *
 * 3. **staticIntent** - Intent with args routes (O(1) lookup) - Matches intent prefix when args are present - Example: "start:123" → `handleArgsCallbackData()`, "/add item" → `handleCommandArgsText()`
 *
 * 4. **dynamicSpesific** - Type-specific free handlers (O(n) iteration) - Runs all `handleFree*` handlers for the message type - Example: `handleFreeText()`, `handleFreePhoto()` - **All matching handlers are executed** (no early return)
 *
 * 5. **dynamic** - Global fallback handlers (O(n) iteration) - Runs all `handleFree()` handlers from pages that define them - Last resort when nothing else matches - **All matching handlers are executed** (no early return)
 *
 * @param ctx - The context instance.
 *
 * @param fromListener - The listener type that triggered the route.
 *
 * @returns The route handler result, or null if no handler answered.
 *
 * @public
 */

 * This method parses `<message>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate rendered message strings. The result is organized by base ID and language. Pre-parsed base blocks can be provided for efficiency.

 *
 * Output shape: - First level key: `baseId` (from `<base id="...">`, or `"default"` if omitted) - Second level key: `lang` (from `<message lang="...">`, or `"default"` if omitted) - Value: `(data?: Record<string, any>) => string`

 * @param template - Raw template string containing `<base>` and `<message>` blocks
 *
 * @param baseBlocks - Optional pre-parsed base blocks for reuse
 *
 * @returns Compiled message functions organized by base ID and language
 *
 * @example

 *   <base>
 *     <message>Hello {{name}}!</message>
 *     <message lang="id">Halo {{name}}!</message>
 *   </base>
 * `;
 * const messages = TemplateEngine.compileBlockMessages(template);

 * ```

/**
 * Recursively processes and resolves `<import>` blocks in a template.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * This method resolves all `<import>` placeholders produced by `_processImportBlocks` by invoking a user-provided `resolver` function.
 *
 * Resolution behavior: - Each `<import>` is resolved by calling `resolver(src)` to obtain raw template content. - The resolved content is filtered using `_extractBlock` based on the import metadata (`blocks`, `base`, `section`, `lang`). - If the resolved content itself contains `<import>` directives, they are processed recursively.
 *
 * Recursion and safety: - Recursive import resolution is limited to a maximum depth of **10** to prevent infinite import loops. - If the depth limit is exceeded, an empty string is returned.
 *
 * Output behavior: - `<import>` placeholders (`__IMPORT_N__`) are replaced sequentially. - If the resolver returns `null` or an empty result, the import is replaced with an empty string.

 *
 * @param depth - Current recursion depth (defaults to 0)
 *
 * @param importCache - Optional Map to cache resolved imports for reuse

 *
 * @example

 * };

/**
 * Validates block positioning and nesting rules in a template string.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * This method checks a template string for structural block nesting violations. It ensures that blocks are placed in their allowed parent contexts.
 *
 * **Nesting hierarchy:**
 * ```
 * __root__
 *   ├── base             (root level only)
 *   │   ├── message      (content block)
 *   │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
 *   │   │   │   ├── case
 *   │   │   │   └── default
 *   │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
 *   │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
 *   │   │   └── space    (utility)
 *   │   ├── keyboard     (content block)
 *   │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
 *   │   │   │   ├── case
 *   │   │   │   └── default
 *   │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
 *   │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
 *   │   │   └── space    (utility)
 *   │   ├── media        (content block)
 *   │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
 *   │   │   │   ├── case
 *   │   │   │   └── default
 *   │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
 *   │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
 *   │   │   └── space    (utility)
 *   │   ├── description  (content block)
 *   │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
 *   │   │   │   ├── case
 *   │   │   │   └── default
 *   │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
 *   │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
 *   │   │   └── space    (utility)
 *   │   ├── import       (utility)
 *   │   ├── description  (utility)
 *   │   ├── script       (logic block)
 *   └   └── space        (utility)
 * ```
 *
 * **Enforced rules:** - `<base>` must be at the outermost level and cannot be nested inside any other block. - `<message>`, `<keyboard>`, `<media>`, `<media-group>`, `<description>`, `<import>`, `<script>`, `<space>` can only appear directly inside `<base>`. - `<media>` can also appear directly inside `<media-group>` as a group item. - `<switch>`, `<map>` can only appear inside `<message>`, `<keyboard>`, `<media>`, or `<description>`. - `<case>` and `<default>` can only appear inside `<switch>`. - Telegram formatting tags (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<u>`, `<s>`, `<code>`, `<pre>`, `<a>`, `<blockquote>`, `<blockquote expandable>`) are passthrough and ignored during validation.
 *
 * @param template - The raw template string to validate
 *
 * @returns An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array containing line numbers and descriptive messages for each violation found
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * // Valid template
 * const result = TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock(`
 *   <base>
 *     <message>Hello {{name}}!</message>
 *     <keyboard>Yes, No</keyboard>
 *   </base>
 * `);
 * // Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
 *
 * // Invalid: <base> nested inside <message>
 * const bad = TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock(`
 *   <base>
 *     <message>
 *       <base>Nested base</base>
 *     </message>
 *   </base>
 * `);
 * // Result: { valid: false, errors: [{ line: 4, message: 'Block <base> is not allowed inside <message>' }] }
 * ```
 *
 * @public
 */
members.name: validatePositionsBlock
